nodes.label: CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index (tract)
nodes.rationale: County averages hide hardest-hit neighborhoods; percentiles are ranks within a release so not comparable across years.

nodes.label: Chronological train/validation/test split
nodes.rationale: Time-based split to avoid leakage.

nodes.label: Common CRS and geometry cleaning (st_zm, st_make_valid, st_transform)
nodes.norm_label: common crs and geometry cleaning (st_zm, st_make_valid, st_transform)
nodes.rationale: NHD XYZM geometry cannot be processed by GEOS, so Z/M dropped and geometry repaired before spatial operations.

nodes.label: Event-level table (one row per EVENT_ID)
nodes.rationale: Details table collapsed with max() not sum, fatalities and locations aggregated separately, because naive joins inflate deaths, injuries and damage.

nodes.label: Feature dictionary
nodes.rationale: Documents role, units, source, leakage note of each column.

nodes.label: gridMET daily precipitation
nodes.rationale: Lets model separate dangerous places from places that simply got most rain; 4 km daily smooths short bursts; explanatory not forecast.

nodes.label: Hurricane Helene Western NC case
nodes.rationale: A single week accounts for a large share of study-county deaths and damage; rare events dominate the toll.

nodes.label: DEM hydrology: HAND and drainage area (WhiteboxTools)
nodes.norm_label: dem hydrology: hand and drainage area (whiteboxtools)
nodes.rationale: Equal stream distance is not equal exposure; low height above stream on large rivers floods more. DEM stops at state line so basins undercounted.

nodes.label: Asheville Helene resident interview
nodes.rationale: Qualitative context mapping onto stream proximity, road crossings, and little warning; included only with confirmed consent; transcribed with Whisper.

nodes.label: ML-ready data export
nodes.rationale: Export guarded: skipped if an enabled feature group is entirely missing, so degraded data never overwrites handoff files.

nodes.label: Combined model table
nodes.rationale: One row per event; narratives excluded because they describe outcomes; coverage-warning flags per row.

nodes.label: NCDOT bridges, structures and culverts
nodes.rationale: Road crossings of streams are where floods damage infrastructure and block access; inventory may be incomplete.

nodes.label: USGS Annual NLCD fractional imperviousness
nodes.rationale: Pavement sheds water fast; year-matched 2016-2023, later events use 2023.

nodes.label: NOAA Storm Events Database
nodes.rationale: Official record of storm outcomes; defines the targets. Damage in nominal dollars; many forecast-zone records lack coordinates.

nodes.label: Partial-year flag
nodes.rationale: Partial year totals incomplete and not comparable with full years.

nodes.label: Quick subset render mode
nodes.rationale: analysis_quick.qmd renders a subset; numbers describe subset only and exports go to subset folders.

nodes.label: NC region assignment (county/forecast-zone matching)
nodes.rationale: Zones matched by name since CZ_FIPS is a zone number; unmatched records never defaulted to a region.

nodes.label: Research question: which storm events become high-consequence and why
nodes.norm_label: research question: which storm events become high-consequence and why
nodes.rationale: Landscape and built environment features help explain high-consequence events.

nodes.label: Cached spatial features
nodes.rationale: Cache reused only when every setting and input is unchanged; refresh_derived_data forces rebuild.

nodes.label: Spatial features measured around each event
nodes.norm_label: spatial features measured around each event
nodes.rationale: Point and buffer measures in EPSG:32119; rasters never resampled, points projected to raster CRS.

nodes.label: USDA SSURGO soils
nodes.rationale: Slow-draining hydrologic groups C/D produce more runoff; only tabular summary, no map-unit geometry so not assigned to events (would invent values).

nodes.label: Western NC study counties
nodes.rationale: Focus region for story numbers and maps.

nodes.label: High-consequence and high-human-impact targets
nodes.rationale: Deaths >= threshold OR damage above quantile of positive damage in training years; threshold computed on training split to avoid leakage.

nodes.label: 3DEP-derived terrain (elevation, slope, roughness)
nodes.rationale: Steep rugged terrain speeds runoff and isolates communities; 62 m cells coarser than native 3DEP.

nodes.label: USGS NHD High Resolution and WBD
nodes.norm_label: usgs nhd high resolution and wbd
nodes.rationale: Flood harm concentrates near moving water; gives stream distance, counts, density, HUC12.

nodes.label: Downloads bundle (tables and ML-ready zips)
nodes.rationale: Bundles all figures, tables and ML files for download.

nodes.label: Limitations
nodes.rationale: 62 m DEM stops at state line; missing coordinates for zone records; NCDOT/NHD are current snapshots; damage nominal; rainfall daily; partial year.

nodes.label: Pipeline log
nodes.rationale: Records every warning, skipped step, and fallback in a render.

nodes.label: Audiences who could use this
nodes.rationale: Emergency managers, NCDOT, schools, residents.

nodes.label: Feature ladder model comparison
nodes.rationale: Gain over previous rung with interval above zero identifies clear value.

nodes.label: Key findings
nodes.rationale: Rare events dominate toll; best CV model PR-AUC vs base rate and season-only; developed places not highest model risk; some groups add nothing measurable (not shown, not irrelevant, given few severe events).

nodes.label: Next steps
nodes.rationale: Stage IV radar rainfall, block-group SVI, flow accumulation/HAND, local validation.

nodes.label: Urban vs rural NOAA reporting caveat
nodes.norm_label: urban vs rural noaa reporting caveat
nodes.rationale: Negative impervious effect may partly reflect how NOAA records events, not separated.

nodes.label: Leakage rules for modeling
nodes.rationale: Never use outcome columns as predictors; split by time; group CV by episode_id; leave spatial NAs missing, not zero.
